description: This Java source file defines a Spring Security configuration class that overrides default security settings to allow access to the root and h2-console endpoints, and disables CSRF and frame options to enable the embedded database console.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class extending WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter to customize HTTP security settings, particularly for allowing access to specific endpoints and disabling certain security protections like CSRF.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default Security configuration to define access rules and disable certain security features.
